summary: @ornikar/stylelint-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xXXXX` identifiers, per-scope string lookup tables) and downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it to run a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` — an approximately 712KB obfuscated JavaScript blob shipped inside the package (numeric/string array with a `WV8StW` rotator function). Using an alternate runtime to execute an opaque, author-controlled payload sidesteps Node-based analysis and any scanners that inspect Node-reachable code. A stylelint configuration package has no legitimate reason to fetch a second JavaScript runtime at install time or to ship a 700KB obfuscated payload. The behavior executes on the installer's machine with the installer's privileges at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
